Hi everyone!
First of all, thank you so much.
I started making cute AI animal videos about three months ago.
At the time, I saw people online sharing tutorials about how they were making money from these videos.
Some claimed they were earning hundreds of euros a day.
And I thought: why not give it a try?
To be honest, my salary from my regular job wasn't enough.
Rent, food, bills, beers… everything was getting more expensive.
I wasn't trying to get rich.
I just wanted to make a little extra money.
Every night I watched tutorials, tried different AI models, and kept experimenting until I got better results.
At first it was pretty frustrating: sometimes the cats had six legs.
Other times their faces changed halfway through the video.
Many times I spent all my tokens and still got nothing I could use…
But I didn't give up.
I started studying which videos went viral.
I learned that showing cute animals wasn't enough.
I needed a story.
I needed emotions.
Something that would make people stop scrolling.
Until one day, one of my videos went incredibly viral.
And today… I'm number one!
I just want to tell everyone here: if I can do it, so can you.
You don't need expensive equipment.
You don't need to be an artist.
You don't even need a real animal!
Don't give up after your first failure.
Your next video might be the one that changes your life.
Thank you so much!
